comparison.objective: Clear only the cartons obstructing a photo-eye beam; candidate adjusts and tests a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR uses spatial reasoning to move selected cartons minimally while keeping them upright. Candidate performs fine tool/collar manipulation and fixture control actuation.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the beam clear, blockers moved ≤10 cm, non-blockers untouched, and all cartons upright and still. Candidate requires two bounded impact cycles without bottoming, overload, rebound, or drift.
comparison.reason: Selective obstacle relocation is unrelated to damper commissioning.
